variants.briefing:
It appears that we've lost contact with a convoy of Citizen for Prosperity ships at [Location] after they reported being attacked in their last comm. 

We believe they will be able to hold off the perpetrators until help arrives, but not indefinitely. We need you to rush to their coordinates and deal with the outlaws before its too late.

Unfortunately, we cannot afford even for a single of these vessels to be lost. As such, this contract will only be considered complete if all ships survive the onslaught. 

Can you help us?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
